changes.to: No maker product page or datasheet for L2.0 was found (the center's WRC 2026 entry lists Linglong L1 and H1 only; checked 2026-11-17), so spec fields stay empty. Press coverage of WRC 2026 and of the 2026 Yizhuang half-marathon reports L2.0 as a firefighting humanoid: 173 cm, 42 active DoF, up to 3 m/s, 560 TOPS edge compute, >95% domestic hardware, heat-resistant suit, RISC-V K3 AI CPU with the OpenLoong control framework. Those figures are press-reported, not maker-published.
Linglong L2.0, the firefighting configuration of the Shanghai humanoid innovation center's biped platform.
